info.description: PPB — identity / community / control / integration plane. Contract §20: snake_case JSON.

Returns the recorded `CommandRun` (the same shape as history), not the raw
PMP value. Fully audited with the **final** result (success / failure) —
never a pre-recorded success.

get.summary: GET /api/v1/admin/config/raw — raw PMP config YAML (plain text).
get.description:
Contract: the Panel consumer reads the raw YAML as a `text/plain` string
(`fetchConfigRaw(): Promise<string>`), not a JSON envelope.

post.summary: POST /api/v1/admin/config/validate — validate form values (§22 `{ ok, errors }`).

get.summary: GET /api/v1/admin/groups — list user groups (typed, with permissions).

post.description:
The Job Policy Registry is the single source of permission / reauth /
executor. Clients supply only a job type — never CLI text (`args.command`
is no longer accepted).

post.summary: POST /api/v1/admin/jobs/tasks/{task_id}/complete — mark an admin task done.

post.description:
Permission is checked per job type (not `dashboard:view`). A job that has
already been dispatched cannot be cancelled (returns 409).

Re-runs the exact same permission + reauth gate as Create (per the job
type's Policy Registry entry) — never a blanket `server:update`.

get.summary: GET /api/v1/admin/logs — recent PMP log history, structured + paginated.

post.description: Requires an elevated reauth context; audit records the FINAL result.

post.summary: POST /api/v1/admin/notifications/send — create an event + fan out inbox rows.

compatibility but is NOT forwarded: PMP `room.create` has no per-room
capacity — the server-wide `max_users_per_room` config applies.
with per-item results and partial failure.

AdminUserItem.description:
Admin user list/detail wire item (§22: `ppb_user_id` UUID, `phira_id`,
`username`/`avatar` naming aligned with Panel).

AppNotificationWire.description: Wire shape of one inbox notification (contract §8).

AuditListResponse.description: Paginated audit list response (§22 `{items, total, page, pageNum}`).

command.description: Raw PMP CLI text (empty for typed action runs).

principal.description: Principal (user id) that initiated the run.

CommandRunListResponse.description: Paginated command history response (§22 `{items, total, page, pageNum}`).

ConfigDiffChange.description: One field-level diff entry `{ path, old, new }`.

ConfigFieldDescriptor.description:
A PMP config field descriptor (Panel renders grouped forms). Schema-freeze
(§22): descriptor carries type/widget/min/max/risk/permission/reload
semantics/sensitive/default.

ConfigFieldGroup.description: A named group of related config fields (Panel renders per group).

ConfigRollbackResponse.description: Typed rollback response `{ ok, restored, health }`.

ConfigValidationError.description: Stable machine-readable field validation issue. `message` is a debug/legacy fallback only.

ConfigValuesBody.description:
Form-value edit body (§22 model A): Panel submits `{path: value}` and PPB
validates/generates YAML/saves.

ConfigValuesResponse.description: §22 typed values response `{ version, values }` (flat `{path: value}`).

is_default.description: Create as the (single) default group — clears any existing default (§23 #4).

GroupListItem.description: Typed group list item (§22: group fields + member_count + permissions).

GroupListResponse.description: Paginated group list response (§22: `{items, total, page, pageNum}`).

GroupMember.description: A group member with the PPB account display fields.

JobListResponse.description: Paginated job list response (§22 `{items, total, page, pageNum}`).

LogEntry.description:
Structured log entry (contract §23 #3 / Panel §18.11).

PMP is the logs source of truth (§13); PPB does not hard-code PMP's internal
payload — each raw line is best-effort structured into this stable shape.
`service` is `"pmp"` for entries sourced from `logs.history`.

LogListResponse.description: Paginated structured log list response (§22 `{items, total, page, pageNum}`).

NotificationDeliveryItem.description: One delivery row `{event_id, type, created_at, delivered}`.

NotificationInboxResponse.description: Inbox response (§22 `{items, total, page, pageNum, unread}`).

PaginationResponse.description: Standard paginated response `{items, total, page, pageNum}`.

ReplayManifest.description: Replay manifest summary for one (round_uuid, player_phira_id).

Risk.description: Risk level attached to a permission.

RoomListResponse.description: Paginated room list response (§22 `{items, total, page, pageNum}`).

RunbookDefinition.description: A runbook definition (stored as JSONB; snapshot on every run).

ServerGatesResponse.description: Typed server gates (§23 #2 real gate read): `{connections, room_creation}`.

ServerStatsResponse.description: Typed PMP server stats (§23 #6: separate typed schema, not a giant status).

SubscriptionWire.description: Encrypted subscription wire shape (before encryption at rest).

TranslateParams.description:
§23 P-91 translate request: Panel sends `{ code }`; `{ error_code }` is
accepted and normalized to `code` for backward compatibility.

TranslatedError.description:
§23 P-91 translated error payload: `{ title, explanation, module, severity,
suggestion? }` — `explanation` (not `description`), `suggestion` optional.

player.description: Best-effort PMP player info (dynamic payload; null when PMP offline).

UserListResponse.description: Paginated user list response (§22 `{items, total, page, pageNum}`).

UserMultiplayerResponse.description:
User multiplayer subview (§23 #5: presence/current_room/ban_state typed;
playtime/rounds/replay counts null when PMP doesn't provide them).

UserSecurityResponse.description:
User security subview (§23 #5).

P-87 carve-out: `ip_history` is PMP `player.ip_history` payload (PMP is the
multiplayer truth source, §13) and stays dynamic JSON rather than a PPB
reverse-engineered schema. `ip_bans` / `banned_at` are always `null` — PMP
exposes no IP-ban list or ban timestamp over OpenUDS, so PPB returns null
rather than fabricating a value.

ReplaySummary.description: Public Replay inventory item backed by PMP round metadata.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable REST error code. Frontends localize by this value, never by message.

ConfigValidationIssueCode.description: Stable field-level config validation reason. Product UI localizes this code; debug message is not formal UI copy.
